title: November Examination
instructions: This paper consists of FIVE questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Show all calculations and include units.
Drawings may be described in words where you cannot draw on screen.

questions.prompt: In first-angle projection, the top view is placed…
Which bridge carries its deck on cables running directly from tall pylons?
A pneumatic system uses…
Which component's resistance decreases as temperature rises?
Amasi is preserved by…
Match each term to its meaning.

pairs.right: Beam supported at one end only
Pressure is transmitted equally in a liquid
Allows turning in one direction only
Usable by as many people as possible

questions.prompt: Accurate measurements can be taken from an isometric drawing along its axes.
Freezing food kills all bacteria.
Explain the difference between one-point and two-point perspective.
questions.memo:
✓ One-point uses one vanishing point (1); the front face is drawn flat ✓ (1)
✓ Two-point uses two vanishing points, and the object is seen from a corner (1)

questions.prompt: Name the forces in (a) the main cables and (b) the towers of a suspension bridge, and in (c) the top and (d) the bottom of a loaded beam bridge.
A community needs a footbridge over a 6 m wide stream. Recommend a bridge type and give TWO reasons.
questions.memo:
✓ Beam or truss bridge (1)
✓✓ Reasons (1 each): short span; cheap and simple; materials available locally; easy to build

questions.prompt: A force of 50 N is applied to a hydraulic piston with an area of 5 cm². Calculate the pressure in N/cm².
The pressure in 3.1 acts on an output piston with an area of 60 cm². Calculate the output force.
Calculate the mechanical advantage of this hydraulic system.
Why is oil rather than air used in a car's braking system?
questions.memo:
✓ Liquids cannot be compressed (1)
✓ so force is transferred immediately and precisely; air would make brakes spongy (1)

questions.prompt: Describe how a cam and follower work and give ONE use.
questions.memo:
✓ The cam is a shaped piece on a rotating shaft (1)
✓ The follower rests on it and moves up and down as it turns, changing rotary to reciprocating motion (1)
✓ Use: engine valves / toys / sewing machines (1)

questions.prompt: A block and tackle has 4 rope sections supporting a load of 2 000 N. Calculate the effort needed (ideal).
A resistor has the colour bands orange, orange, red, gold. What is its value in ohms?
Calculate the total resistance of a 470 Ω and a 330 Ω resistor in series.
Calculate the total resistance of two 200 Ω resistors in parallel.
Explain how a heat alarm using a thermistor, a transistor and a buzzer works. Identify the input, process and output.
questions.memo:
✓ Input: thermistor; process: transistor; output: buzzer (1)
✓ When the temperature rises, the thermistor's resistance falls (1)
✓ The base voltage of the transistor rises above about 0,7 V (1)
✓ The transistor switches on and the buzzer sounds (1)

questions.prompt: Why must an LED be connected the correct way round, and how do you identify its negative leg?
questions.memo:
✓ It only allows current in one direction (it is a diode) (1)
✓ The negative (cathode) leg is shorter / next to the flat edge (1)

questions.prompt: Explain how drying and pickling preserve food, with an example of each.
questions.memo:
✓ Drying removes water so microbes cannot grow (1) ✓ e.g. biltong / dried fruit (1)
✓ Pickling uses acid (vinegar) to stop microbes growing (1) ✓ e.g. atchar / pickled onions (1)

questions.prompt: Give THREE functions of the packaging on a box of breakfast cereal.
questions.memo: Any three (1 each): protect; preserve/keep fresh; contain; inform (ingredients, expiry); promote; easy to stack and transport

questions.prompt: Give an example of bias in technology and suggest how the design could be made more inclusive.
questions.memo:
✓ Example of bias, e.g. building without a ramp (1)
✓ Group disadvantaged, e.g. wheelchair users (1)
✓ Inclusive solution, e.g. ramps and lifts (1)

questions.prompt: Discuss TWO positive and TWO negative impacts of motor vehicles on society and the environment.
questions.memo:
Positive (1 each): fast transport of people/goods; jobs; access to services; trade
Negative (1 each): air pollution/greenhouse gases; accidents; congestion; use of fossil fuels; noise
